get.summary: Compliance returns the compliance state of a single validator.
Parameters queries the parameters of the module.
Ep queries the accumulated Empirical Points for a single validator.
Parameters queries the parameters of the module.

Snapshot queries the Participation Score snapshot for a validator at a
given epoch.

SnapshotRange queries Participation Score snapshots for a validator across a
closed epoch range. Epochs with no record are omitted rather than returned
empty — a missing epoch means the validator was not processed then, which is
different from a zero score.
Parameters queries the parameters of the module.

RewardSnapshot returns the reward decision for a validator at an epoch:
eligible + minted amount, or ineligible + denial reason.

RewardSummary aggregates a validator's emissions over a closed epoch range.
The card behind this needs a month at a time; a month is ~5 200 epochs, so
the summing happens here rather than over HTTP.

chain.compliance.v1.ComplianceEventType.description:
ComplianceEventType classifies the event that last changed a validator's
compliance state. See chain/docs/validators/README.md §4.2.

 - COMPLIANCE_EVENT_TYPE_IDENTITY_FAILED: Identity verification failed (medium severity).
 - COMPLIANCE_EVENT_TYPE_KYC_EXPIRED: KYC/AML re-attestation expired (medium severity).
 - COMPLIANCE_EVENT_TYPE_EXTERNAL_FLAG: External compliance flag set by admin (high severity).
 - COMPLIANCE_EVENT_TYPE_CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Critical protocol violation, e.g. double-sign (critical severity).
 - COMPLIANCE_EVENT_TYPE_RESTORED: Compliance restored (re-attestation completed / flag cleared).

chain.compliance.v1.ComplianceState.description:
ComplianceState is the source-of-truth compliance record for a validator,
stored in x/compliance. The boolean C flag is mirrored into
x/validatorregistry.ValidatorMetadata.ComplianceFlag for fast gates
(invariant V-4.1).

compliant.description: compliant is the C flag: true = compliant (C=1), false = non-compliant (C=0).

last_event.description: last_event is the most recent compliance event affecting this validator.

last_event_time.description: last_event_time is when last_event was recorded.

reason.description: reason is a free-text human-readable explanation for the last event.

validator_address.description: validator_address is the operator (valoper) bech32 string.

unjail_cooldown_blocks is the minimum number of blocks a validator must

chain.rewards.v1.Params.description:
Params defines the parameters for the module.

v0.1 MOCK emission model (Decision D2 — independent gated emission): each
eligible validator (status==active AND C==1 AND EP>0) is minted a flat
reward_per_epoch_amount of denom "nscn" once per epoch — nscn is the base
denom; SCN is nscn x 10^8. The full EP-proportional / inflation-scheduled
reward curve is DEFERRED.

blocks_per_year.description:
blocks_per_year converts the ANNUAL security budget into a per-epoch target.

Epochs are counted in BLOCKS, never wall-clock (Register §2.1), so the
conversion must be too: epochs_per_year = blocks_per_year /
x/participation.epoch_length_blocks. Keeping the epoch length in
x/participation and only the yearly block count here avoids storing the same
fact twice, which is how the two drift apart.

Default 6,311,520 — the x/mint precedent for 5-second blocks.

budget_bonded_rate.description:
AnnualSecurityBudget = clip(bonded_rate x TotalBonded,
                              floor_rate  x CurrentSupply,
                              ceiling_rate x CurrentSupply)

Stored as decimal strings (LegacyDec) so governance can tune them within the
bounds ADR-0013 will set. Defaults are the Register's adopted values
0.15 / 0.005 / 0.0075 divided by seven (S6, 2026-09-24). The Register values
were inputs to the Stage 5 calibration rather than outputs of it.
budget_bonded_rate.title:
budget_bonded_rate, budget_floor_rate and budget_ceiling_rate are the three
clip constants of the Register's annual security budget (ADR-0011 D1):

enabled.description:
enabled is the kill-switch for emission. When false, DistributeEpochRewards
is a no-op (no minting). Default true.

reward_per_epoch_amount.description:
reward_per_epoch_amount was the flat per-validator reward of the v0.1 mock
emission model.

SUPERSEDED by the annual security budget (fields 4-6, ADR-0011 D1): the
epoch pool is now sized from total bonded stake and current supply, then
split among the eligible validators. This field is retained so existing
genesis files and param sets still decode, and is no longer read by the
emission path. It will be removed once no live chain carries it.

chain.rewards.v1.QueryRewardSummaryRespo.description:
QueryRewardSummaryResponse is the response for Query/RewardSummary.

epochs_with_record is how many epochs in the range produced a snapshot at all;
epochs_paid is how many of those were eligible. The difference is the number of
recorded denials, which is what makes "broke yesterday" distinguishable from
"never worked".

chain.rewards.v1.RewardSnapshot.description:
RewardSnapshot is the per-epoch, per-validator emission record produced by
DistributeEpochRewards. It captures whether the validator passed the
eligibility gate (status==active AND C==1 AND EP>0) and, if so, the minted
reward. Ineligible validators get an eligible=false record with a reason and
an empty amount (the foundation for invariant V-2: EP=0 -> reward=0).

amount.description: amount is the minted coins string (e.g. "1000000scn"), empty when not eligible.

reason.description:
reason explains the eligibility decision ("eligible", "not active",
"non-compliant", "EP=0", or "disabled").

chain.stakeengine.v1.CapState.description:
CapState is the per-epoch snapshot every check during that epoch reads, so a
check gives the same answer in simulation and in execution.

epoch.description: epoch is the epoch these values were computed for (0 at genesis).

ewma_bonded.description: ewma_bonded is the smoothed total bonded the per-validator cap is drawn from.

chain.stakeengine.v1.Params.description:
Params are the tier-2 (governance-bounded, ADR-0013) parameters of the stake
engine. The entry floor is NOT here: it is a tier-1 code constant,
EntryFloorNscn, so governance has nothing to lower.

ewma_window_epochs.description: ewma_window_epochs is N in the EWMA of total bonded, alpha = 2 / (N + 1).

excluded_addresses.description:
excluded_addresses are accounts whose holdings are not publicly owned —
treasury, team, foundation, vesting. Everything they hold is subtracted from
public circulating supply. Empty on the devnet.

max_fills_per_block.description: max_fills_per_block bounds the work EndBlock does filling the queue.

max_queue_entries.description: max_queue_entries bounds the queue's size in state.

max_supply_fraction.description:
max_supply_fraction is the first arm of the global bonded cap:
global_cap = min(max_supply_fraction x max supply, public_circulating_fraction x public circulating).

min_queue_entry.description: min_queue_entry is the smallest amount, in nscn, a queue entry may carry.

public_circulating_fraction.description: public_circulating_fraction is the second arm of the global bonded cap.

validator_cap_floor.description:
validator_cap_floor is a lower bound on the per-validator cap, in nscn. On a
network with few validators "2% of the network" is meaningless; the floor
keeps delegation possible until there are validators to share it. Default 0
(the strict rule); the devnet genesis sets it explicitly.

validator_cap_fraction.description:
validator_cap_fraction is the share of the EWMA of total bonded that one
validator may hold before it stops accepting new delegation.

headroom.description:
headroom is global_cap - total_bonded; negative when the cap fell below what
is already bonded.

entry_floor.description: entry_floor is the tier-1 constant, reported so a client need not hard-code it.

room.description: room is validator_cap - tokens; negative for a validator above its cap.

chain.stakeengine.v1.QueueEntry.description:
QueueEntry is stake waiting for room under the global cap. Its coins are held
in the stakeengine module account until the entry is filled or cancelled.

amount.description: amount is what remains to be filled, in nscn.

chain.validatorregistry.v1.Status.description:
Status defines the validator status in the SAiCoN Proof of Participation model.
See chain/docs/validators/README.md §2 and chain/docs/adr/ADR-0003-validator-status-enum.md.

Status numeric values are FROZEN — never reuse or rename. Add new statuses
with numbers 7+ only.

 - STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: STATUS_UNSPECIFIED is the proto3 default — should never appear in runtime
state. Encountering it indicates a bug (uninitialized field).
 - STATUS_BONDING: STATUS_BONDING — validator registered, lock-up activated, awaiting activation.
 - STATUS_ACTIVE: STATUS_ACTIVE — validator in active set, participating in consensus.
 - STATUS_QUARANTINED: STATUS_QUARANTINED — compliance violation detected; isolated from consensus
but stake remains locked.
 - STATUS_JAILED: STATUS_JAILED — severe violation (double sign, prolonged downtime).
 - STATUS_UNBONDING: STATUS_UNBONDING — voluntary unbond requested, cooldown in progress.
 - STATUS_INACTIVE: STATUS_INACTIVE — validator fully exited; state can be removed after grace.

chain.validatorregistry.v1.ValidatorMeta.description:
ValidatorMetadata holds SAiCoN-specific validator state, extending Cosmos SDK
x/staking with status enum, lock-up tracking, and compliance flag.

Source-of-truth for: status, lock-up timing.
Cached: compliance_flag (mirror of x/compliance for fast gates).

See chain/docs/validators/README.md and ADR-0003.

bonding_start.description:
bonding_start is the timestamp when validator entered STATUS_BONDING.
Used to enforce the self-stake lock-up.

bonding_start_height.description:
bonding_start_height is the block height at which the lock-up window began
(validator first bonded / registered). Frozen for this validator — unlike
last_status_change_height it never moves on later transitions. The V-3
EndBlock invariant uses it to distinguish a self-stake exit created WHILE
locked (a real bypass -> halt) from a pre-lock exit that was created before
the validator ever locked and merely lingers into the window (legitimate,
must NOT halt the chain).

compliance_flag.description:
compliance_flag is a cached mirror of x/compliance state for fast gates.
Invariant V-4.1: must always equal x/compliance.LastEvent.Compliant.

last_status_change_height.description:
last_status_change_height is the block height of the last status transition.
Used for audit and for some invariant checks (e.g. cooldown).

lockup_duration_seconds.description:
lockup_duration_seconds is the configured lock-up period at bonding time.
Frozen for this validator: changing chain param does not extend existing.

pre_unbonding_status.description:
pre_unbonding_status is the status the validator held when it left the bonded
set, recorded so an ABORTED exit can be undone without guessing.

Both ACTIVE and QUARANTINED enter STATUS_UNBONDING, so on a re-bond the prior
status is not recoverable from the status field alone; restoring blindly to
ACTIVE would let a validator launder a quarantine by unbonding and re-bonding.
The compliance_flag mirror cannot stand in for this: it is hardcoded to true
on the registration and auto-create paths and its V-4.1 invariant is not yet
enforced, so it is not a source of truth.

STATUS_UNSPECIFIED means "not recorded" (a record that entered unbonding
before this field existed); the restore treats that as untrusted and returns
the validator QUARANTINED rather than ACTIVE.

status.description: status is the current SAiCoN validator status (see Status enum).

unbonding_complete_time.description:
unbonding_complete_time is the instant the unstake cooldown ends, copied from
x/staking's validator.UnbondingTime when unbonding begins. It is frozen at that
moment, so a later governance change of the staking UnbondingTime parameter
cannot retroactively turn a legitimate exit into an invariant violation.
Zero when the validator has never begun unbonding. Used by invariant V-5.

unbonding_start.description:
unbonding_start is set when validator transitions to STATUS_UNBONDING.
Zero/unset value means not unbonding.

validator_address.description: validator_address is the operator address (valoper bech32 string).

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise
